name: print-social-blue-hiring-for-our-business-story-with-chair-and-megaphone
title: Blue 'We Are Hiring For Our Business' story with a white card, leather chair and megaphone
whatItIs: A vertical blue story with a white card holding 'We Are Hiring For Our Business' in black and blue mixed weights, a black 'Open Positions' label and chevron role rows, a black leather chair with a blue megaphone overlapping the card edge, contact icons and a navy footer.
whatItMeans: Professional and bold; the product-style chair photo makes the vacancy feel premium.
techniques: Overlap the prop onto the white card edge.
Vary weights line by line in the headline.

vocabulary.definition: A small arrow marker for list items.
